newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona cargo traffic rises one third in October.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona cargo traffic rises one third in October.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport increased 32.7 percent in October compared with the same month last year to 8,567 tonnes, the airport authority said.
The total for the first 10 months of 1996 now stands at 64,847 tonnes, 18.8 percent above the same period 1995.
Most of the growth came from international freight which rose 45.7 percent to 5,077 tonnes. Domestic cargo business was 17.4 percent higher in the month at 3,490 tonnes.
Passenger numbers were 15.5 percent higher in October at 1.19 million excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 10.96 million, a rise of 13.7 percent.
